lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Sparse grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular spots aligned in roughly vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the gill region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal linear ridges visible along the upper flank, defined by a sharp intensity transition from high-luminance upper surfaces to shadowed lower edges.
